text:
Lina: Dropping a new compact trace drilldown mock in Figma: tightened header, collapsible frames by default, and an inline copy affordance for the trace identifier. link: https://figma.com/...
Rohit: Nice. Quick Q: do we want the inline ID to say "Trace ID" or "Request ID" (we've used both).
Priya: Use "Trace ID" in the trace view, "Request ID" in request-level UIs. Keeps terms scoped to context.
Marta: +1. Also: visual affordance suggestion: show a small document icon next to copy so it's discoverable, but keep the label short.
Doug: Accessibility: make the copy control a <button> with aria-label="Copy trace id" and provide an sr-only status update on success with aria-live="polite". Need a visible focus ring and 4.5:1 contrast for the pill background/text.
Priya: Interaction note: copying should not open the kebab menu or move focus. If keyboard user hits Enter on the pill, announce "Trace ID copied" then focus stays where it was.
Lina: Good call. For collapsed frames, how do we expose "Expand all" without polluting the header? Thinking micro-toggle in the left gutter.
Marta: Left gutter toggle is fine, but ensure it's reachable by keyboard and screenreader text like "Expand frames". Also add a tooltip that reads "Expand stack frames".
Rohit: Export UX: current options are "Download snapshot (json)", "Export HAR", "Download zipped trace". We should pick a simpler surface: primary action "Export snapshot" with a sub-menu offering formats.
Doug: Runtime caveat: large traces may need server-side streaming and packaging. Backend imposes a 40MB zip limit; if size exceeds, show a clear message and suggest filtered export (time window, service filter). Also capture telemetry when users abort export.
Priya: From clarity POV, the kebab menu should show format icons and a machine-readable label, e.g. "Export snapshot (.json)" so screen readers get context.
Lina: UX flow proposal: clicking Export opens an inline modal with format radios, estimated size, and a progress bar. If size > limit, modal shows filters to reduce size. Keep keyboard-first: trap focus, ESC closes.
Marta: A11y nit: progress updates must be exposed via aria-live="assertive" when export completes/fails. Intermediate progress should be polite.
Rohit: What about naming the file? Users prefer predictable names. Proposal: {product}-{traceId}-{YYYYMMDD}.json or .zip. Also a short description in the save dialog for screen readers.
Doug: Backend will populate suggested filename; UI should allow copy-to-clipboard for the name before download so users can paste elsewhere. Also include a small help link: "Why did export fail?" with common reasons.
Priya: Stack frames: long file paths currently wrap awkwardly. Suggest truncating middle with tooltip showing full path on hover/focus. That keeps layout tidy and is keyboard-friendly.
Marta: For screen readers, expose the full path in an aria-label on the frame button while visually showing the truncated path. Example: aria-label="File /long/path/app/service/handler.js line 245".
Lina: Grouping frames by service was requested by support. Micro-control to toggle "Group by service" in the view header?
Rohit: Yes, and persist choice per-user. Also add a small legend explaining grouping rules (by binary/service name then by thread).
Doug: Dev note: when grouping is enabled we need stable IDs for groups to animate expand/collapse without reflowing focus. Use data-qa attributes for tests.
Priya: Keyboard flow check: Tab across header controls, then into list. Use arrow keys to move between frames within a collapsed group; Enter expands. Document this in interaction spec.
Marta: Copy stack snippet feature: allow selecting a frame and "Copy stack snippet" which copies a small context (3 lines) plus function names. Make it visible in kebab and as a right-click.
Lina: UX copy: short labels on buttons, but aria-labels verbose. E.g., visible "Copy snippet"; aria-label "Copy stack snippet for selected frame, includes 3 lines of context".
Rohit: One more: when users export, include correlation IDs and trace links in the meta so reimporting or sharing is easier. Tagging format should be stable across versions.
Doug: Logged a follow-up task: backend export metadata, streaming endpoint, and file-naming schema. ID: ENG-TR-782.
Marta: QA checklist: keyboard nav, NVDA/VoiceOver verification for collapse/expand, tooltip announcements, export progress, truncation tooltip accessible via keyboard, color contrast.
Priya: I'll draft the interaction spec with the aria examples and a11y checklist. Lina, can you update Figma to reflect the modal and gutter toggle?
Lina: On it  will push an updated frame with annotations and link back when done. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
ExportBot: Export preview: estimated size 12.3MB for trace 8a1f2c. If >40MB export will be disabled and filters suggested.
